notes: Reconciled from blind labelers A and B, who gave the same 6 patch pairs; they differed only in wording (which end each foot is on, wall depth). Real double-skin scan (t ~1.36 mm) of a ~280x238 mm flat plate, partial bending stage. Part frame: u toward wall 3/4, w = top-skin normal. Perpendicular sections confirm 6 rounded formed folds: (1) a 90 deg wall 3/4 along the full u+ edge (v -132.7..105.5, ~237 mm), ~9.5 mm deep, dropping to ~14.5 mm over the last ~20 mm at each end; (2) a 90 deg wall 7/8 along part of the v+ edge (wall u 37..129.4, ~15 mm deep, two ~5 mm round holes at w ~-10, well clear of the fold). Its formed arc runs only u 36.8..124.6 (~88 mm), because a relief slot separates the wall's last ~5 mm from the plate, so B2 uses extent_t to end at the arc; (3, 4) two outward 90 deg Z-return feet at the bottom of wall 3/4, one at each end (11/14 at v 85..105, beside wall 7/8; 12/13 at v -132.6..-112.6), ~20 mm long and ~13 mm deep; (5, 6) a lanced joggle tab on the v- edge (u ~66.5..111.4, slits on both sides): plate to 15 deg ramp to a flat tab offset ~3 mm, i.e. two 15 deg folds. The u- edge, the v- edge outside the tab and the v+ edge for u<37 are plain thickness edges. Both skins are flat to +-0.3 mm with smooth gradients and no kink lines. The top-skin dropouts (a square near u 58..88 and a strip near u -85..-55) and the scattered noise near patch 15 sit over a continuous flat bottom skin, so they are scan artifacts, not features. Each bend is marked once on its outer (convex) skin. Inner/mixed duplicates [1,4], [1,8], [3,14], [3,12], [1,9], [6,10] are the same folds.

bends.note: Main ~89 deg fold, plate to wall 3/4, along the full u+ edge (~237 mm). Outer skin: 2 = plate top, 3 = outer wall face.

~90 deg fold, plate to wall 7/8, along the v+ edge (~88 mm). Outer skin: 2 = plate top, 7 = outer wall face. Two round holes in the wall at mid-depth, clear of the fold. The formed arc runs u 36.8..124.6. For u 124.6..129.4 the wall's last ~5 mm is cut free of the plate by a relief slot: the plate's cut edge sits at v ~104.5, the wall's top cut edge at w ~-2.7, and no arc points lie between them. The auto extent (t -120.21) ran ~3.2 mm into that slot, so extent_t ends the line at the arc end (t -117.0) and keeps the auto start (t -29.03).
Outward ~90 deg Z-return foot at the bottom of wall 3/4, at the end next to wall 7/8 (v ~85..105, ~20 mm). Convex side: 4 = inner wall face, 11 = foot underside.
Outward ~90 deg Z-return foot at the bottom of wall 3/4, at the opposite end (v ~-132.6..-112.6, ~20 mm). Convex side: 4 = inner wall face, 13 = foot underside.
Joggle fold 1 (~15 deg), plate to ramp, at the root of the lanced tab on the v- edge (u ~66.5..111.4, ~45 mm). Convex side is the top skin: 2 + 10.
Joggle fold 2 (~15 deg), ramp to tab, with the tab offset ~3 mm (u ~67..111.4, ~44 mm). Convex side is the bottom skin: 9 + 5.
